senses.gloss: f. (ἀπόφασις, ἀπόφανσις) verdict, dispensation. [Variously corrupted: איפופסין, איפוספ׳, איפרפס &c.] Y’lamd. to Gen. III, 1 quot. in Ar. (ref. to Prov. XVIII, 7) the fools give out האפופסין שלהן their own verdict.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 44:1">Pesik. R. s. 44</cite> <cite ref="A01474"><he>איספוסין</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02633"><he>אפוספיס</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 46:1">Pesik. R. s. 46</cite> (ed. Fr. p. 187ᵇ) <he>ניתן פאופרי</he> read <he>נטל א׳</he> he received his verdict (of expulsion from Eden).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:5:2">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᵈ</cite> bot.; Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵃ bot. <he>איפ׳</he>; a. fr. [Tanḥ. Sh’moth 13 <he>שנטלו אפופסים</he>, read <cite ref="A02619"><he>אַפּוּכִי</he></cite>.]—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 670">Yalk. Ps. 670</cite> two curiosi (v. <cite ref="E00660"><he>הנדיוסין</he></cite>) <he>רצין בהפרכוס</he> (<he>באין באיפרפוס</he>) (read <he>באפופסיס</he>) run (come) each with a verdict; v. <cite ref="B00023"><he>בָּאיָין</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21">Lev. R. s. 21</cite>, beg. <he>אפופסיות</he> Ar., read with ed. <cite ref="A02638"><he>אפופסיס</he></cite>.
